model: CZ-NSMB A2W Modbus PCB for Aquarea air-to-water heat pumps
applies_to: Panasonic CZ-NSMB Modbus PCB fitted inside Panasonic Air-To-Water control boxes; the manual's compatibility list names the A2W M-Series control module WH-CME8 and the Big A2W 20-30 kW outdoor units WH-WXG20/25/30ME8 with control module WH-CME8L (user manual M02412F0). Some registers carry H/J/K/L-series conditions.
summary: The CZ-NSMB is Panasonic's own Modbus RTU slave board that plugs into the CN-CNT connector of an Aquarea air-to-water unit. All points are holding registers: on/off, operating mode, zone and tank setpoints, compensation curves, smart-grid settings, quiet and powerful modes, sterilisation and system reset requests, plus readings of outdoor, water, tank and zone temperatures, error codes, energy use and generation, and unit configuration.

addressing.note: Registers are listed by protocol address starting at 0 (address 0 = Operation on/off), so the printed address goes on the wire unchanged.

source.title: User Manual - A2W Modbus PCB - Model no. CZ-NSMB
source.pages: p. 4 compatible models; pp. 7-13 installation, quick start, LEDs; p. 14 interface specification; pp. 15-27 register list; pp. 28-29 DIP switches; pp. 30-33 error codes

notes: The manual gives no data type per register. Values whose printed range goes below zero (temperatures, water-shift setpoints, curve outdoor limits, tank re-heat and cool capacity shifts) are listed as INT16; all others as UINT16.
Temperatures are whole degrees Celsius by default. DIP SW2 P1 ON switches all temperature registers to tenths (x10) and P2 ON to Fahrenheit; the scale of 1 here matches the default.

32-bit totals at 120/121-130/131 and 366/367-372/373 are left out: the manual marks them only '(MSB)' or not at all and never says which register holds the high word. 184/185 (compressor hours) is printed as [MSB/LSB] and is listed as UINT32 with the high word first.
Many registers apply only to some series ('If K series onwards', 'If M series'); the condition is quoted in the description. 213 and 437 apply to Big A2W variants.
Error code 52 encodes the remote-controller code: 1XX = Hxx, 2XX = Fxx, 3XX = Uxx (e.g. 214 = F14), per the manual's error-code section (the register table itself prints 1XXX/2XXX/3XXX).
Write 1337 to 378 to clear the consumption counters.

integration.summary: Fit the PCB on the CN-CNT connector, set address and baud with SW1, then poll holding registers 0-52 for state and temperatures and write 0 (on/off), 4 (mode), 12/13 or 226-229 (zone setpoints) and 30/33 (tank).
integration.enable: No software enable: connect the supplied CN-CNT cable to the unit's main (or optional) PCB, connect CN2 to the RS-485 bus and set the slave address and baud rate on DIP SW1.
quirks: Serial format is 8N2 by default; 8N1 is also supported.
Supported functions: 3, 4, 6 and 16; all points are holding registers.
Mode codes 8-11 (Auto Heat, Auto Heat Tank, Auto Cool, Auto Cool Tank) are read-only states.
setup: DIP SW1 sets slave address (default 1) and baud rate 9600 (default), 19200, 57600 or 115200.
DIP SW2 P8 switches in the 120 ohm termination (default off).
Up to 63 CZ-NSMB boards per bus; one heat pump per board.
On Big A2W outdoor units the PCB sits in the C-BOX and the bus lands on terminals U1/U2.
gotchas: LED D3 flashing means the heat pump has not finished initialising; registers may not be valid yet.
The remote controller and Modbus can be used at the same time.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
